objective: Audit extreme-point rounding for nu_star-J=O(r). Prove the conditional leaf-only Q-J<=a+b bound and an all-order optimal-extreme-point obstruction to permanently freezing integral core triangles. The unrestricted two-prefix target and both admitted obligations remain open.

atomic_claims.text: After integral core triangles are chosen, an extreme leaf-only optimum has at most a+b fractional edge groups, with an explicit injection into active tagged endpoint rows. Hence 0<=Q-J<=a+b. Fractional residual capacities do not satisfy this proof premise.
The joint model for (r,a,b,p,q)=(5,2,4,1,1) has the displayed optimal rank-eleven extreme point with quarter-valued coordinates; ordinary matching half-integrality is not applicable.

For r=19^k and G(r,2,4,1,1), a specified optimal extreme point has integral core part P_k. Permanently fixing P_k leaves an exact deficit ell_k=(8/19)r log_19(r), whereas the true gap nu_star-J is one.
Reopening only s original integral triangles increases the frozen optimum by at most 2s. Thus a uniformly linear reopening allowance does not suffice for that preprocessing rule.
The split host family has nu_star=binom(r,2)/3+2, J=nu=binom(r,2)/3+1, and cp=7. This is not a superlinear counterexample to the target.

Actual bounded exact runs check 149 boundary-inclusive capped tuples with r<=4 using two LP and two integer implementations; 1056 leaf-residual cases; one named r=5 point; and k=1,2 product witnesses with twelve rejected mutations. These are generator-side finite checks only.

assumptions: Finite simple graphs; triangle packing is edge-disjoint, and cp is exact edge partition into nonempty clique edge sets.
The two-prefix joint model and J retain actual core-edge ownership and the two tagged endpoint budgets; a zero count or empty class creates no positive variables.
Q optimizes over integral core packings with fractional leaf allocations. Its leaf charging lemma assumes residual capacities in {0,1}.
Finite LP duality and extremality are mathematical inputs. Graph-specific charging, design, parity and integer arguments are written out.
Two fixed triangle lists in templates.json are proof inputs only through exact edge-list verification, not their floating MILP discovery metadata.
risks: The full inequality nu_star-J<=K*r is not proved or disproved; nu_star-Q=O(r) with unrestricted core reselection is still open.
The negative result concerns permanent freezing or only O(r) reopenings of the old integral support. Temporary subtraction, better optimal-point selection and unrestricted exchanges are not excluded.
The constructed host is split/chordal, but its residual Cartesian product need not be chordal; no residual chordality is assumed.
The two-level gap statement, weaker uniform o(n^2) theorem, exact split domination and frozen root have different statement identities.
Finite checks do not prove universality or exhaust a continuous optimal face. No complete parameter range above core order four is claimed in C25.
